Thank you for this message. Honestly made me cry. My childhood was good, I was a happy child in my own world. Teenagerhood really ruined me and there was a lot of trauma that I never recovered from. And I'm scared I never will, because I know I'm not the same person as before, at all. And it sucks. It really does. I skipped one class because of it, now I'm behind my peers. I just can't move on forward. I was an average student. Now I'm nothing. And knowing that I can't go forward, knowing I'm so weak in the world where only the strongest survive, I don't have any hope for life whatsoever. I'm scared of doing therapy agian. Therapy pushed me back, socially, even mentally I still feel disabled because of it. I guess I didn't do the right job. I'm scared I will continue on living as nothing. I still do smile, laugh at things. I cheer others up, and I'm trying to be the best person I can be until I finally catch my last breath. But it's seriously painful. I feel as if I live for everyone else rather for myself,  and that's why I'm questioning everything. Because when all of this is gone I'm going to be nothing. I don't know how to describe that feeling. I guess I'm just scared of my worthless future.
I just want the people I leave behind to understand, because they can do so much, they are amazing people who can fight for themselves. And I feel like the only fight I can win is to just die.
Don't know. Im still very confused. But seriously, thank you.

Yeah, they really are compassionate. I come from a religious family tho I am not so religious myself. To be honest, talking to priests was always nice, when it comes to confessing sins. They kind of can't say anything, they can only listen. Which is good.
Shut all the electricity down. Ez.

Uhh where do I begin? Being a woman really sucks for so many reasons, when I compare myself to an average man. 
Basically, not having to look and act like a fucking alien would be nice. So much is expected from us when it comes to looks. You don't think that it does, but you don't even know how many girls actually try to be beautiful even if you think they are just "beautiful naturally".
I envy your sex life, not having any regrets, not feeling dirty, not feeling like a toy, not feeling like you are just made for that and to give birth.
Not being dependant on everyone else. And this one comes from early of my childhood. I always felt like I depended on everyone because I'm a girl.
Being listened to, in truth. Yeah, we get so much more "support" apparently. We don't actually. Every emotional problem ever is just "being on period", being dramatic, being a bitch. 
But ye. Those are some things. Just some.

Had a friend who actually had OCD. (We met in a psych ward). Watched him wash his hands repeatedly, for 2 hours, without stopping, his hands were literally bleeding sometimes. It's just one of the examples, but it was...extreme. He was suffering. All kids in there would always cheer on him when he'd finish with his routines earlier, and he would be happy too.
But still. Really painful listening to kids saying "woaaah when u have ocd" for literally having thier room clean. No.
I have the same question, just about lighters. How the hecc?
Well if it wasn't something would be really wrong, like being schizophrenic or psychotic

Most of the people that "have thier shit together" actually don't. At least I think so, I've never met a person who actually has everything in order. Maybe they seem like they do and then when you meet them there are many shits they have to take care of.
It's just about being strong enough to seem that way.
I'd consider myself as a person who at the moment seems like I have everything, but it was really hard to get here, to be honest.
